name: Qubaz Suites
loc: Jalan Kampung Tiong, Kuala Terengganu, Terengganu
overview: Qubaz Suites is a hotel-concept serviced apartment development on Jalan Kampung Tiong, at the edge of Kuala Terengganu's Chinatown and close to the waterfront. One tower of 759 units on 1.45 acres combines a modern Islamic design with sea and river views, concierge-style services and retail at ground level. Homes for sale are 2-bedroom (506 sqft) and 3-bedroom (753 sqft) units, and they come fully furnished.

loc_text: Qubaz Suites sits on Jalan Kampung Tiong at the edge of Kuala Terengganu's Chinatown, a heritage area almost 300 years old, facing the South China Sea and the mouth of the Terengganu River. Chinatown is less than 1 km away, Pasar Payang, the Kuala Terengganu Waterfront and Pulau Warisan are close by, the islands are a short boat ride away and Sultan Mahmud Airport is about 15 minutes by car.
